payload.evidence_against: T041 direct pseudo-cut rankings have only 0.16 mean Spearman and fail controls. Earlier global routers over weaker path pairs also failed transfer, and the development panel contains only 100 wells.
payload.evidence_for: T041's seven-candidate oracle reaches 5.883054 and selects every path family. Exact HMM posterior standard deviation/log-likelihood, PF/HMM/E011 path disagreement, candidate spread, and observable well geometry are legal diagnostics that do not use the rejected pseudo-cut losses and are materially closer to the actual failure modes.
payload.next_test: Run T042 with a frozen feature table, four preregistered multi-output loss predictors, whole-well v1 cross-fitting, hard/guarded/soft placement, and target-shuffle plus candidate-rotation controls. Use the remaining 673 wells only after a complete screen pass.
payload.statement: Full-path disagreement and posterior-state diagnostics can cross-fittedly predict which public-core candidate will minimize whole-well loss strongly enough to improve the fixed E011/PF blend.
payload.title: Posterior state predicts public-core candidate loss
